story: No friction for small payments, even to a suspicious account: ¥300 goes straight through.

steps.caption: A customer asks for a small transfer: ¥300 to an account the bank has some doubts about.
The teller keys it in at the counter.
That account is only a few days old and many people have paid it this week. But ¥300 is too small to matter.
Accepted at once. No alert, no case, no questions for the customer. Small payments are never held up.

do.text: Nothing unusual. The transfer was accepted.
